name: qualcomm-wifi-ieee80211
description: Parses Qualcomm/Atheros 802.11 kernel driver log messages including station association, authentication, and node management events

test_samples.input: [776303.366550] [wifi0ap1] ieee80211_set_node_vid node c0:49:ef:8c:07:2c lan[0] dvlan stas 0

expect.message: ieee80211_set_node_vid node c0:49:ef:8c:07:2c lan[0] dvlan stas 0

test_samples.input: [776303.355204] wlan: [0:I:ANY] [UNSPECIFIED] vap-1(wifi0ap1): [c0:49:ef:8c:07:2c]station associated at aid 2: short preamble, long slot time, QoS, HT40 cap 0x31

expect.message: station associated at aid 2: short preamble, long slot time, QoS, HT40 cap 0x31

test_samples.input: [776303.355151] ieee80211_update_node_ecm_flags: node with aid 2 and mac c0:49:ef:8c:07:2c has been tagged [ dvlan ecm accelerated ]

expect.message: node with aid 2 and mac c0:49:ef:8c:07:2c has been tagged [ dvlan ecm accelerated ]

test_samples.input: [776303.307492] wlan: [0:I:ANY] [UNSPECIFIED] vap-1(wifi0ap1): [c0:49:ef:8c:07:2c]recv auth frame with algorithm 0 seq 1 rssi:44 minrssi:0

expect.message: recv auth frame with algorithm 0 seq 1 rssi:44 minrssi:0

test_samples.input: [776303.307533] wlan: [0:I:ANY] [UNSPECIFIED] vap-1(wifi0ap1): [c0:49:ef:8c:07:2c]recv another auth frame when previous is in progress

expect.message: recv another auth frame when previous is in progress

test_samples.input: [ 3456.017129] [wifi0ap1] ieee80211_set_node_vid node c0:49:ef:8c:07:2c lan[0] dvlan stas 0

expect.message: ieee80211_set_node_vid node c0:49:ef:8c:07:2c lan[0] dvlan stas 0

test_samples.input: [ 3456.001043] wlan: [0:I:ANY] [UNSPECIFIED] vap-1(wifi0ap1): [c0:49:ef:8c:07:2c]station associated at aid 2: short preamble, long slot time, QoS, HT40 cap 0x31

expect.message: station associated at aid 2: short preamble, long slot time, QoS, HT40 cap 0x31

test_samples.input: [ 3456.000935] ieee80211_update_node_ecm_flags: node with aid 2 and mac c0:49:ef:8c:07:2c has been tagged [ dvlan ecm accelerated ]

expect.message: node with aid 2 and mac c0:49:ef:8c:07:2c has been tagged [ dvlan ecm accelerated ]
